summary: Frontend-only test of static homepage (/ -> inicio.html) category dropdowns, menu-item loader/redirect, INSCREVA-SE flow, external links and tracking. All 6 requested features PASS on desktop 1920x800 and mobile 390x844.

issues: Cosmetic only: when the loader opens right after a hover-click, the submenu's 0.2s collapse transition is briefly visible as a faint box behind the semi-transparent loader overlay. Nothing breaks.

critical_code_review_comments: Menu items use href='/' with JS preventDefault + 2s timeout. Fine. With JS disabled they still go to '/', which is acceptable.
Hover/focus-within CSS sets the desktop submenu height to a fixed 100px. That works for 4 items at 22px line-height, but adding a 5th item would clip it.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: desktop hover over #ancora-concurso/vestibular/avaliacao shows 4 items (Próximos, Inscrições Abertas, Em Andamento, Encerrados; uppercase via CSS). Submenu is 100px tall and items sit at 234-322px, fully inside it. Mobile 390px: click shows 4 items, the correct category submenu is topmost (checked with elementFromPoint and bg color), scrollWidth=390, no overflow. Clicking menu-{cat}-{i} shows home-loader and lands on '/' after about 2s. INSCREVA-SE shows the loader and goes to /termos.html on desktop and mobile. No http(s) or // hrefs. POST /api/track/access returns 200. Use wait_until='load'. page.tap needs a hasTouch context, so use click instead.
